/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /workspace/results && /opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
reader=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/fracture.vti']); reader.PointArrayStatus=['Scalars_']
pd=TTKPersistenceDiagram(Input=reader); pd.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']; pd.ForceInputOffsetField=False
pd.UpdatePipeline()
print('pd ports',pd.GetClientSideObject().GetNumberOfOutputPorts())
for port in range(pd.GetClientSideObject().GetNumberOfOutputPorts()):
 d=servermanager.Fetch(OutputPort(pd,port)); print(port,d.GetClassName(),d.GetNumberOfPoints(),d.GetNumberOfCells(), [d.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())], [d.GetCellData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetCellData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
th=Threshold(Input=pd); th.Scalars=['CELLS','Persistence']; th.LowerThreshold=0.05; th.UpperThreshold=1e99; th.UpdatePipeline()
d=servermanager.Fetch(th);print('th',d.GetNumberOfPoints(),d.GetNumberOfCells(),[d.GetCellData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetCellData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
top=TTKTopologicalSimplification(Domain=reader,Constraints=th); top.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']; top.UpdatePipeline()
d=servermanager.Fetch(top);print('top',d.GetClassName(),d.GetNumberOfPoints(),[d.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
msc=TTKMorseSmaleComplex(Input=top);msc.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_'];msc.MorseSmaleComplexSegmentation=True;msc.UpdatePipeline()
print('msc ports',msc.GetClientSideObject().GetNumberOfOutputPorts())
for port in range(msc.GetClientSideObject().GetNumberOfOutputPorts()):
 d=servermanager.Fetch(OutputPort(msc,port));print('out',port,d.GetClassName(),d.GetNumberOfPoints(),d.GetNumberOfCells(),[d.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())],[d.GetCellData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetCellData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY"
